breaking.change: Replaces frequency/damping and tip multipliers with independent stiffness and drag. Chains use complete Parent world matrices, segment collisions and joint-local collider radii. Animation state format is 2; old snapshots are not supported.
breaking.fix: Author stiffness (acceleration per metre) and drag (velocity decay per second) explicitly. Set tailOffset for leaf tails, teleportDistance and maxSpeed for reset/capping, wind for wind coupling, and worldColliders for optional world collision. Recreate old saves.

breaking.change: Extracted motion is reported as rootDelta and rootYawDelta; rootMotionMode selects direct Transform motion or collision-safe controller movement.
breaking.fix: Use rootMotionMode controller with CharacterController for swept root displacement. Read the Skeleton deltas instead of inferring desired motion from Transform changes. New controller input rootDelta is consumed once.

breaking.change: Requires an explicit skin-joint whitelist; never infers a humanoid from names. Rigs are built from the rest pose and entity world scale. Each bone supports mass, shape, jointKind, hingeAxis and asymmetric twist bounds.
breaking.fix: Pass the bones array or author RagdollRigDesc. Supply a nonzero bone-local hingeAxis for hinges, and author the desired joint bounds.

breaking.change: Dynamic bones must be selected in boneMask (empty means none); layers/mask are explicit and zero disables contacts. Owner capsules and adjacent bones are excluded pairwise, not by a global layer. Activation uses COM velocities and mass-weighted total impulse; blending is local-space FK.
breaking.fix: Set boneMask to rig indices and layers/mask to the desired collision groups. Set motorStiffness/motorDamping for PD drive and driveTransform to follow the root. Use applyRagdollImpulse for a world-space point hit on one bone. Recreate old physics snapshots.

breaking.change: Locks are world-space across Parent motion and drop their anchor immediately beyond maxDistance. Ground adaptation and ankle normal alignment respect weight.
breaking.fix: Set groundReach for PhysicsQuery ground rays and pelvisDrop for optional pelvis adaptation. Use maxDistance to release teleports without pulling a leg towards the old anchor.

breaking.change: Returns an exact Mat4 inverse rather than an inexact TRS under rotated non-uniform scale.
breaking.fix: Use inverse_transform_point for points, or multiply the inverse matrix with matrices. Use Mat4::transform_point3 for matrix point transforms.

fixed: Two-bone IK uses a relative safe reach interval and solves hinge constraints before root alignment; look-at rear-seam hysteresis is opt-in.
Ragdoll tunables update existing bodies without discarding velocity; rigs and targets are removed when their owner despawns.
